sections.heading: Investment & project terms
sections.subheading: Transparent milestones and clear scope boundaries.

terms.title: Milestone payments
terms.body: 50% upfront deposit to initiate development, 30% upon approval of main website pages, and 20% prior to final launch and domain live connection.

terms.title: Ownership & handover
terms.body: Upon final payment, full ownership of custom website design and assets is transferred to your business with no ongoing lock-in.

terms.title: Service rates & areas
terms.body: Client supplies accurate lists of covered neighborhoods, license numbers, warranty policies, and service pricing.

terms.title: Warranty support
terms.body: Includes 30 days of free technical and bug support after deployment to ensure zero downtime.

sections.calloutBody: Prices are fixed development estimates for the scope listed. Applicable third-party services (hosting, domain, SMS credits) are confirmed in writing before purchase.
